facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 6 to 23 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the third highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Corral Pass (5,810 ft) and the lowest at Cayuse Pass (5,260 ft) and Morse Lake (5,400 ft).

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 11 and July 11, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.
